Name: Downhill Landslide
Author: WSAEZ
Description:
[size=4][b]Downhill Landslide[/b][/size]
An addon for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url] by Kiyugamods.

[b]What it does[/b]
[list]
[*]The narrow, dangerous path from Downhill to Pelican Town now comes out among the trees beside the mountain exit, instead of on top of it. It feels like a separate hidden trail.[/*]
[*]The warning sign is serious now: each time you take the path there is a small chance (10%) of an accident. Rocks fall, the ground gives way, or you trip on a root, and you lose a little health (5-10 HP).[/*]
[*]Like falling down a mine shaft, the damage is not shown as a number. You only see a message and your health bar drop.[/*]
[*]It can never knock you out: your health never goes below 1.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32872]Downhill Project[/url][/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Extract the zip into your Mods folder and run the game with SMAPI.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Works with the Downhill Project bridge shortcut option on or off.

[b]Translations[/b]
English, Portuguese, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish and Chinese. Corrections from native speakers are welcome.

Manifest.Name: Downhill Landslide
Manifest.Description: Moves the Downhill dangerous path exit into the trees beside the mountain exit, with a small chance of landslide damage.
